name: outpost
description: Callback addresses that record DNS lookups, web requests and mail, read on your machine

tools.name: outpost_addresses
tools.description: Get the channel's callback addresses, creating the channel on first use

tools.name: outpost_list
tools.description: List the records that reached the addresses

tools.name: outpost_assemble
tools.description: Reassemble data sent as many lookups of one token

tools.name: outpost_serve
tools.description: Set what a token's web address answers: status, headers, body, cross-origin rules

tools.name: outpost_responses
tools.description: List or delete the responses the channel serves

api_url.title: Outpost API address
api_url.description: Base address of your Outpost instance's API, for example http://127.0.0.1:9080

api_key.title: Outpost API key
api_key.description: The instance's API key, used to create channels
